---
title: "Dashboard template"
description: "A dashboard: an app shell with a brand, a navigation and a user menu fixed, and a page header for each page."
---

A template renders `AppShellLayout`, fixes part of it, and exposes props for the rest. It is copy-code: the file is yours to edit.

## Preview

**Anatomy** names each slot and what fills it. The panel changes the props live; the fixed parts stay.

## How it uses the layout

The template fills these slots of `AppShellLayout`. Each slot is fixed by the template, filled by a prop, or not used.

<SlotMap layout="AppShellLayout" template="dashboard" />

| Layout slot | Filled with | Fixed or prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AppShellLayout.header` | brand, user menu, navigation trigger on small screens | fixed |
| `AppShellLayout.sidebar` | navigation, with aria-current on the active link | fixed |
| `AppShellLayout.sidebar` | activeHref | prop |
| `AppShellLayout.main` | a PageLayout (page structure) | fixed |
| `PageLayout.header` (in `AppShellLayout.main`) | title, description, breadcrumbs, actions | prop |
| `PageLayout.content` (in `AppShellLayout.main`) | children | prop |
| `PageLayout.aside` (in `AppShellLayout.main`) | not used | – |

## Fixed and variable

**Fixed by the template** (edit the constants at the top of the file):

- Brand
- Navigation with `aria-current`
- User menu
- Navigation trigger on small screens

**Props** (the variable part):

- `title`, `description`, `breadcrumbs`, `actions`
- `activeHref`: the current page
- `children`: the page content

## Install

<RegistryCommand name="dashboard-template" />

## Code

The template is one file, and a page uses it. The page sets only what varies: no heights, no overflow.
